opening.argument: The material is presented as a warning about a purported Walmart gift-card hoax, not as an invitation to pursue the offer. The narration explicitly identifies the subject as “one very, very popular hoax” and tells viewers, “don't answer any questions, don't click anything that claims you're going to go and answer a survey all of that is fake stuff.” Although the displayed offer presents a Walmart gift card and a survey question, and the narration describes claims involving a free reward, a survey, clicking a Facebook app, and sharing personal information, those elements are described as deceptive mechanisms to avoid. The stated purpose is to “help people that it's a scam and educate everyone around,” reinforcing that the interface is being examined to warn viewers rather than promote participation.
